name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Salvatore De Meo
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided not to lift the legal immunity of Salvatore De Meo, an Italian member of the Parliament. Belgian prosecutors wanted to charge him with passive public bribery over a dinner paid for by Huawei and other gifts and favours. The Parliament found the request too vague and unclear to make a confident decision, and said the uncertainty could suggest he was being targeted unfairly. This is a decision on his immunity only, not a ruling on whether he is guilty.

- **What changes:** De Meo keeps his immunity, so Belgium cannot pursue the bribery case against him for now.
- **Who it affects:** De Meo himself and the Belgian prosecutors who requested the waiver.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's President sends the decision to the Belgian authorities and to De Meo.
